messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 502/504 errors detected on api-gateway-edge
incident-bot: Severity: P1 -> Investigating | region: us-west-2 | started: 03:22 UTC :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Dashboard: dashboard://gateway/errors/1894123456 | Runbook: runbook://edge-502-504

Priya: I got paged. pulling metrics+logs now. seeing a sharp rise in 502/504 starting 03:20, peaking ~20% errors for incoming requests to /v1/chat.

Lee: Confirmed. Error traces show a mix of 502 from proxy and 504 timeouts. p95 latency also up. No recent infra deploys in last 45m according to deploy-bot.

Dana: I'm checking upstreams. embedder- and router-pools in us-west-2 show increased connection resets. kube events show transient node Rebooted events around 03:18 for a few nodes.

Priya: hmm, nodes rebooting could explain socket pressure. Is this limited to a node subset or across the cluster?

Lee: filtered by pod host -> problem concentrated on hosts ip-10-3-7-10..14. Other hosts look fine. Traffic to those hosts returns 502 quickly.

infra-bot: note: AWS reported brief networking maintenance in us-west-2 at 03:15-03:19 (link: https://status.aws.example/notice/uw2-net).

Dana: that aligns. Action plan:
- short-term: divert ~40% traffic away from affected hosts/pools (Priya)
- temp-enable aggressive retry with jitter on gateway (Lee)
- cordon and drain affected nodes (Dana)
- escalate to infra if AWS networking ongoing (Priya)

Priya: applying LB target exclusion for the affected backend set, keeping health-checks enabled. CLI:
```
lbctl modify-targets --target-group embedder-west --exclude-hosts ip-10-3-7-10,ip-10-3-7-11 --reason "mitigate 502 spike"
```
Priya: command executed at 03:27 UTC. seeing immediate drop in 502 from global 20% -> 9% within 90s.

Lee: enabling short retry policy for gateway to swallow transient faults: 2 retries, backoff 200ms.
Lee: patch applied to edge-config and gradually rolled.

support-bot: Customer Impact: 03:20-03:29 window saw increased failures for ~9% of requests originating in us-west. No data corruption. Logging flagged highest error rate for customers using synchronous completion endpoints.

Dana: starting drain of affected hosts. kubectl drain ip-10-3-7-10 --ignore-daemonsets --force
Dana: pods rescheduled to healthy nodes. monitoring socket stats.

Lee: even after excluding hosts and retries, occasional 504s persist for long running streaming sessions. Hypothesis: proxy upstream keepalive pool exhausted or half-open sockets due to abrupt resets from host NIC.

Priya: good catch. let's increase proxy upstream connection pool size temporarily and shorten keepalive timeout to free sockets faster.

Lee: updating edge-proxy config (hot reload supported):
```
EDGE_CONN_POOL_SIZE=120 -> 200
EDGE_KEEPALIVE_TIMEOUT=60s -> 15s
apply-config --service api-gateway-edge
```
Lee: pushed at 03:33 UTC. observing reduction in long-tail 504s.

infra-bot: AWS maintenance update shows issue resolved at 03:25 UTC but with residual host-level resets affecting some EC2 instances.

Dana: because nodes were rebooted, some kernel timers and conntrack entries might be stale. I'll run a conntrack dump on drained nodes before we reprovision.

Priya: scaling the embedder pool by +30% as contingency while drains complete.
Priya: k8s scale command issued at 03:30 UTC.

Lee: with host exclusion, retries, pool tuning, and scale, total 5xx has dropped to ~1.5% by 03:36 UTC. user-facing errors mostly resolved.

support-bot: Notifying Trust Ops and customer success with initial impact summary. Drafting first-touch message for affected customers.

Dana: follow-up checklist:
- preserve pcaps and conntrack dumps from affected nodes (Dana)
- review node reboot root cause with infra (Priya)
- consider automating host-exclusion on node-reboot events (Lee)
- add ephemeral port/socket saturation alerts to SRE dashboards (Lee)

Priya: I'm going to un-exclude the hosts once they are verified healthy. marking hosts for rejoin after full health checks complete.

Lee: reverting aggressive retry and connection pool back to safe defaults now that system stabilized.

infra-bot: lbctl log: target-exclusion removed for embedder-west at 03:42 UTC by Priya.

Priya: incident declared mitigated at 03:42 UTC. timeline summary:
- 03:15 AWS networking notice
- 03:20 error spike observed
- 03:27 LB host exclusion + retries
- 03:30 scale-up + drains
- 03:33 proxy pool/keepalive tuning
- 03:42 normal traffic restored

Priya: owners for follow-ups:
- Incident writeup & timeline: Priya
- Node-level forensic (pcap/conntrack): Dana + infra-sre
- Alerting/dashboard work: Lee
- Customer comms: Support Ops

Dana: I'll upload artifacts to the incident folder and schedule postmortem for tomorrow.

Lee: suggest adding an automated play to blacklist hosts that show >X reboots in Y minutes and to correlate with cloud provider maintenance windows.

support-bot: Final severity: downgraded to P2. Incident thread archived and copied to incidents log. :white_check_mark:
